edges.reason: msg.sender is used in the constructor to receive the entire initial supply into balances
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written by approve
msg.sender balance is the source of funds debited by transfer
msg.sender allowance is debited by transferFrom without an allowance requirement check
balances mapping is indexed by the untrusted msg.sender
constructor writes _totalSupply
constructor writes balances for msg.sender
totalSupply executes an unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply
totalSupply reads _totalSupply
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)]
transfer calls safeSub for the sender balance debit
transfer calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit
transfer writes updated balances into state storage
transferFrom calls safeSub on balance and allowance
transferFrom calls safeAdd on the recipient balance
transferFrom writes updated balances into state storage without allowance validation
transferFrom writes the allowed mapping of an arbitrary from address
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender]
tokens amount flows into safeSub for subtraction
tokens amount flows into safeAdd for addition
tokens amount determines the magnitude of the balances state write
to address indexes the credit side of the balances state write
from address indexes the debit side of the balances state write
from address keys the allowed mapping consumed by transferFrom
safeSub result is stored into balances
safeAdd result is stored into balances
operand a flows into safeAdd
operand b flows into safeAdd
safeAdd returns its result in local c
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf
spender parameter becomes the allowance key in approve

normalization_plan.reason: tokenOwner is only used as the lookup key of balanceOf and encapsulates no independent semantic state
spender is only meaningful as the allowance key written by approve
tokens is the transferred amount consumed by transfer's arithmetic state updates
to is only meaningful as the credit recipient of the transfer state write
from is only meaningful as the debit source of transferFrom and its allowance key
operand a is a pure input of the SafeMath arithmetic routine safeAdd
operand b is a pure input of the SafeMath arithmetic routine safeAdd
local c holds the result of safeAdd and has no lifetime beyond that call
